name: Spirit's Blessing returns a regalia to material deck, wakes the champion, draws a card
notes: Spirit's Blessing's element is CRUX, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real CRUX champion (Lorraine, Crux Knight) to unlock element access; the champion is also pre-rested (Status 1) so the wake-up is observable. Necklace of Foresight (a REGALIA,ITEM) is seeded directly onto the field as the additional-cost fuel returned to the material deck. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 1-reserve cost is paid, then both players decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window before the ability's own MZCHOOSE (which regalia to return) resolves, waking the champion and drawing a card.

rulesClauses: As an additional cost to activate this card, return a regalia you control to your material deck. Wake up your champion. Draw a card.
